mechanistic_claims.claim: Active Co is strongly spin-polarized / HS-like.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_support: Co moments 3.20-3.25 muB in *OH; strongly covalent HS-like center.
mechanistic_claims.vasp_support: VASP moments near 3 muB support strong polarization.
mechanistic_claims.vasp_values: VASP mCoact(*OH)=2.941 muB pristine, 3.140 muB Al16

mechanistic_claims.claim: Exchange splitting makes frontier spins inequivalent.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_support: Large local Co spin and unequal alpha/beta populations.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_values: Coact *OH local spin pristine=3.215, Al16=3.224 muB (Hirshfeld)
mechanistic_claims.vasp_values: spin-resolved PDOS and COHP channels are unequal near EF

mechanistic_claims.claim: The redox-active occupied frontier state is minority-spin.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_support: Al CP2K Oads loss is alpha-dominant, not beta/minority relative to positive Co.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_values: Al16 Oads Hirshfeld Delta N_alpha=-0.586, Delta N_beta=+0.159 e; active Co spin remains positive
mechanistic_claims.vasp_support: LOBSTER Oads 2p loss is spin-down dominated.
mechanistic_claims.vasp_values: LOBSTER Oads 2p Delta N_up=+0.160/+0.220 and Delta N_down=-0.660/-0.680 e (pristine/Al16)

mechanistic_claims.claim: The redox-active state has dominant Oads 2p character.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_support: Oads is dominant electron-loss site in both CP2K partitions.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_values: Hirshfeld Delta N(Oads)=-0.464 e pristine, -0.427 e Al16
mechanistic_claims.vasp_support: Oads p feature dominates the selected near-EF proxy and loses most projected population.
mechanistic_claims.vasp_values: largest Oads spin-down PDOS peak in -1..0 eV occurs at -0.096633 eV pristine and -0.109159 eV Al16

mechanistic_claims.cp2k_support: Co population/spin respond and Co+adsorbate hole is cheaper than Co-only hole.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_values: N-1 penalty: Co-only=4.889-5.269 eV; Co+adsorbate=2.874-3.390 eV
mechanistic_claims.vasp_support: Co 3d overlaps Oads 2p near EF; Co-O COHP is finite.
mechanistic_claims.vasp_values: finite Coact 3d PDOS at the Oads peak and ICOHP(*OH)=-1.92767/-1.93011 eV

mechanistic_claims.claim: It has a definite Co-O bonding character.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_values: null: no CP2K orbital-resolved frontier COHP/PDOS
mechanistic_claims.vasp_support: Pristine: approximately nonbonding; Al16: weakly antibonding near the Oads-down peak proxy.
mechanistic_claims.vasp_values: spin2 local mean -COHP=-0.001402 pristine (approximately nonbonding), -0.030390 Al16 (weakly antibonding)

mechanistic_claims.cp2k_values: null: no bond-aligned CP2K orbital projection
mechanistic_claims.vasp_support: Global orbital axes and no orbital-resolved p-d COHP prevent secure assignment.
mechanistic_claims.vasp_values: null: global VASP axes; no bond-aligned orbital-resolved p-d COHP

mechanistic_claims.cp2k_support: Co-O distance/orbital energy not directly quantified in CP2K cDFT populations.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_values: null: CP2K population analysis does not provide ICOHP
mechanistic_claims.vasp_support: Delta(-ICOHP) = +1.46490 eV pristine and +1.11234 eV Al16.

mechanistic_claims.cp2k_support: Alpha/beta populations change differently on Co and O.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_values: Al16 Oads Delta N_alpha=-0.586, Delta N_beta=+0.159 e (Hirshfeld)
mechanistic_claims.vasp_support: Spin-resolved ICOHP and orbital populations reorganize differently.
mechanistic_claims.vasp_values: Delta(-ICOHP) spin1/spin2=+0.56027/+0.90463 eV pristine; +0.20887/+0.90347 eV Al16

mechanistic_claims.claim: Material-dependent rehybridization occurs predominantly in majority spin.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_support: CP2K is not orbital-bond resolved and does not establish this channel universally.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_values: null: CP2K output is not orbital-bond resolved
mechanistic_claims.vasp_support: Difference in bond strengthening is 0.35140 eV in spin1 and 0.00116 eV in spin2.
mechanistic_claims.vasp_values: pristine-Al difference in Delta(-ICOHP)=0.35140 eV spin1 and 0.00116 eV spin2

mechanistic_claims.claim: Neighboring Co provides low-energy magnetic d-state coupling.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_support: Mapped neighboring Co has finite spin/population response.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_values: Mapped CP2K neighbor is Co45 (pristine) or Al32 (Al16); see absolute populations
mechanistic_claims.vasp_support: Coadj 3d PDOS is spin polarized near EF and bridge COHP responds.
mechanistic_claims.vasp_values: Coadj frontier PDOS integral=2.449529 states (-2..+0.5 eV); Coact-Obridge Delta(-ICOHP)=+0.070270 eV

mechanistic_claims.claim: Al lacks an equivalent low-energy magnetic d manifold.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_support: Mapped Al has near-zero local spin.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_values: Al32 is the mapped neighboring atom; its local spin is small relative to Co
mechanistic_claims.vasp_support: Al local moment is about 0.003 muB and lacks Co-like magnetic 3d PDOS.
mechanistic_claims.vasp_values: Al frontier s+p+d integral=0.012442 states and mAl about 0.003 muB

mechanistic_claims.cp2k_support: Co Delta N is +0.219 to +0.012 e (Hirshfeld) and M+2 penalty rises by 1.137416 eV.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_values: Hirshfeld Delta N(Coact)=+0.219 e pristine vs +0.012 e Al16; Co-only M+2 penalty=2.899188 vs 4.036604 eV
mechanistic_claims.vasp_support: Co moment drop is reduced and spin1 Co-O strengthening is smaller.
mechanistic_claims.vasp_values: Delta mCoact=-0.107 muB pristine vs -0.033 muB Al16; spin1 Delta(-ICOHP)=+0.56027 vs +0.20887 eV

mechanistic_claims.claim: The oxidized state is more O-centered with Al.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_support: Oads remains main redox center while Co response is strongly suppressed.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_values: Hirshfeld Delta N(Oads)=-0.464/-0.427 e while Delta N(Coact)=+0.219/+0.012 e (pristine/Al16)
mechanistic_claims.vasp_support: Bader and LOBSTER show O-centered spin/population response with smaller Co d net change.
mechanistic_claims.vasp_values: Bader Delta N(Oads)=-0.260692/-0.224205 e; LOBSTER Co 3d Delta N=+0.08/+0.04 e (pristine/Al16)

mechanistic_claims.claim: Oads spin polarization reverses in Al16.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_support: Yes in both CP2K Mulliken and Hirshfeld.
mechanistic_claims.cp2k_values: Al16 Oads m=+0.339262 to -0.462897 muB Mulliken; +0.336 to -0.408 muB Hirshfeld
mechanistic_claims.vasp_values: VASP Oads m=+0.328 to +1.028 muB in Al16; no sign reversal
